sections.description:
AskAny is the most comprehensive AI chatbot and live support solution for WordPress, trusted by thousands of websites worldwide. Combining cutting-edge AI technology with human support capabilities, AskAny delivers 24/7 customer service, intelligent product recommendations, and seamless WooCommerce integration that transforms visitors into customers.

🚀 AskAny AI | 📖 Documentation | 💬 Pro Support

Whether you run a WooCommerce store or a content-rich WordPress site, AskAny combines AI chat, PDF search, and contextual understanding to provide the most intelligent customer support chatbot experience.

Let’s grow, connect, and build together! 🚀

🎯 Why Choose AskAny Over Other AI Chatbots?

✅ Multi-AI Provider Support – OpenAI GPT-4, DeepSeek, Google Gemini – switch providers instantly
✅ AI Response Language – Select the language for AI responses. “Auto” will match the user’s question language. Selecting a specific language will force all AI responses in that language
✅ Live Agent Handoff – Seamless AI-to-human support transition in real-time
✅ WooCommerce Native – Product cards, cart integration, order assistance built-in
✅ PDF Knowledge Base – Upload manuals, policies, guides for intelligent responses
✅ External Website Indexing – Crawl and learn from external sources
✅ Server-Sent Events (SSE) – Real-time messaging with 90% less server load
✅ Form Integration – Contact Form 7, Simple Form, WPForms, Gravity Forms inside chat
✅ Advanced Analytics – Comprehensive chat statistics and performance metrics

🔥 Revolutionary Features That Set AskAny Apart

⚡ Industry-First SSE Technology
AskAny is the only WordPress AI chatbot using Server-Sent Events for true real-time performance:
– 🌐 90% Less Server Load – Ultra-light performance with no heavy polling
– ⚡ Instant Message Delivery – Real-time responses like WhatsApp/Telegram
– 🛡️ Automatic Fallback – Seamlessly switches to polling if SSE unavailable
– 📱 Zero Configuration – Works instantly without technical setup

🤖 Advanced AI Integration
– Triple AI Provider Support: OpenAI GPT-4, DeepSeek, Google Gemini
– Smart Model Selection: Automatic failover between providers
– Context-Aware Responses: Remembers conversation history
– Intelligent Fallback System: Local responses when AI unavailable
– Custom Q&A Pairs: Override AI with specific business responses

👥 Hybrid AI + Human Support
– Live Agent Dashboard: Real-time chat management interface
– Seamless Handoff: AI-to-agent transition without losing context
– Agent Assignment: Assign specific agents to conversations
– 24/7 Coverage: AI handles off-hours, agents take complex queries

🛍️ WooCommerce Powerhouse
Transform your online store with intelligent shopping assistance:
– Product Cards: Rich product displays with images, prices, stock
– Smart Recommendations: AI-powered upselling and cross-selling
– Cart Integration: Add products directly from chat

📚 Intelligent Knowledge Management

– External Website Crawling: Index content from any website
– WordPress Content Integration: Automatic posts/pages indexing

– Multi-Source Learning: Combine internal and external knowledge

🎨 Advanced Customization

– Custom Branding: Upload avatars, customize colors, headers
– Responsive Design: Perfect on desktop, tablet, and mobile

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/askany directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure the plugin settings in the AskAny menu
  4. Add your AI API keys (OpenAI, DeepSeek, or Gemini)
  5. Index your content and upload relevant PDFs
  6. Add the chat widget using shortcode or automatic placement

Quick Setup Guide

Step 1: Get Your API Key
To use AskAny’s AI features, you need an API key from one of the supported providers:

  • OpenAI: Register at OpenAI Platform to obtain your key
    • Find your key at: OpenAI API Key Location
  • DeepSeek: Register at DeepSeek Platform to obtain your key
  • Google Gemini: Log in to Google AI Studio to generate your Gemini API key

Step 2: Configure AskAny
1. Go to AskAny AI > Settings in your WordPress admin
2. Select your preferred AI provider
3. Enter your API key
4. Test the connection
5. Customize your chat widget appearance

Step 3: Add Knowledge
1. Go to AskAny AI > Content Index to automatically index your WordPress content
2. Visit AskAny AI > PDF Files to upload documents and manuals
3. Use AskAny AI > External Sources to index external websites
4. Add custom Q&A pairs in AskAny AI > Q&A Management

Step 4: Deploy Your Chatbot
– Enable the floating widget in settings, or
– Use the shortcode [askany_chat] on any page or post
– Customize the position, theme, and behavior to match your site
sections.faq:
Which AI models and providers are supported?

AskAny supports multiple AI providers for maximum flexibility:
– OpenAI: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4.1, O4-mini
– DeepSeek: DeepSeek-Chat (cost-effective option)
– Google Gemini: Gemini 2.0 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite

You can switch between providers or use multiple providers with automatic failover.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! AskAny has native WooCommerce integration that includes:
– Product information display with images and pricing
– Real-time stock status and availability
– Smart product recommendations
– Direct add-to-cart functionality from chat
– Order tracking and customer support

Can it read and search PDF documents?

Absolutely! AskAny can process and index PDF documents, making their content searchable through the chat interface. Simply upload PDFs through the admin panel, and the AI will automatically extract and index the content for intelligent responses.

How is chat history and user data handled?

  • Chat history is stored locally in your WordPress database
  • Data retention periods are fully customizable
  • Users can clear their chat history manually
  • All data processing is GDPR compliant
  • Built-in privacy controls and data export tools

Can I customize the chatbot’s appearance?

Yes! AskAny offers extensive customization options:
– Upload custom avatars and icons
– Adjustable widget positioning
– Responsive design for all devices

How does the live agent handoff work?

AskAny features seamless AI-to-human support transition:
– Agents can take over any AI conversation in real-time
– Context and conversation history are preserved
– Agents receive notifications for new conversations
– Performance analytics track AI vs human interactions
– 24/7 AI coverage with human escalation when needed

Is it compatible with page builders and themes?

Yes! AskAny works with all major WordPress themes and page builders:
– Page Builders: Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, Gutenberg
– Themes: All WordPress themes (tested with popular ones)
– Caching: Compatible with WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, LiteSpeed
– Forms: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms

How do I add the chatbot to my website?

You have multiple options:
1. Floating Widget: Enable in settings for site-wide display
2. Shortcode: Use [askany_chat] on any page or post
3. Widget: Add to sidebars using the WordPress widget

What makes AskAny different from other chatbot plugins?

AskAny stands out with unique features:
– Multi-AI Provider Support: Switch between OpenAI, DeepSeek, Gemini
– Server-Sent Events: Real-time messaging with 90% less server load
– Live Agent Integration: Seamless AI-to-human handoff
– Advanced Knowledge Base: PDF processing + external website indexing
– Native WooCommerce: Built-in e-commerce features
– Enterprise Features: Advanced analytics, database management

Can I use it for lead generation?

Yes! AskAny includes powerful lead generation features:
– Integrated contact forms within chat
– Custom Q&A flows for lead qualification
– User information collection and storage
– Integration with popular form plugins
– Analytics to track conversion rates

Is technical support available?

We provide comprehensive support:
– Free Support: WordPress.org support forum
– Documentation: Complete setup and usage guides
– Video Tutorials: Step-by-step video instructions
– Community: Active user community for tips and tricks
– Pro Support: Priority support for Pro users

How do I optimize performance?

AskAny is built for performance:
– Enable Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time messaging
– Use database optimization tools in the admin panel
– Configure caching plugin compatibility
– Optimize AI provider selection based on your needs
– Regular database cleanup and maintenance
